title: Homological Algebra of Knots and BPS States
note: arXiv:1112.0030v2 [hep-th], Geom. Topol. Monogr. 18 (2012) 309-367. Added 2026-08-02 from library/arxiv-1112.0030v2/1112.0030v2.pdf (authors verified from the arXiv title page: Sergei Gukov, Marko Stošić). The knot-homology ↔ BPS-states bridge: reduced/colored HOMFLY homology of a knot K is the space of **open** BPS states of the M5-brane on the conormal Lagrangian $L_K \subset T^*S^3$ (§1–2; Appendix C computes the $H_3(4_1)$ colored homology of the figure-eight). For QOU: assessed as the candidate published conjecture licensing the G3 Stokes integer $A_\omega = 3$. The non-degeneracy check (PR of 2026-08-02) finds the OPEN-HOMFLY count of $4_1$ is $\det(4_1)=5$ (5 HOMFLY generators / 5-node quiver, via the knots–quivers correspondence kucharski-reineke-stosic-sulkowski2017), NOT the GGM resurgent-Stokes spectrum $\{3,4\}$ — a DISTINCT BPS sector. So this bridge does NOT license $A_\omega=3$; the licensing conjecture is the closed / state-integral resurgent-Stokes = DT/BPS identification (garoufalidis-gu-marino2023peacock Conjecture 3(d) + gukov-pei-putrov-vafa2017).
